classification: conditional capacity upper bound; not a decoder
assumptions: Red spans remain on their original pages, ordered and non-overlapping; touching is allowed.
Fixed-length model preserves each span length; variable-length model preserves per-page span count and total red-rune count only.
Only two unique large-mark positions are treated as independently movable; the other 28 are tied to span endpoints or page ends.
Every large mark is generously allowed four independent size/colour states.
Pooled fine punctuation labels and all 55 residual-line bits are added independently, even where physical channels may overlap.
The 55 residual-line bits are an optional upper bound, not an authenticated or source-selected cipher channel.
decision: Structured ink geometry plus pooled fine punctuation labels remains below the global deficit. It crosses only if all 55 residual-line bits are independently available; no source-selected readout or plaintext is established.
